summary: User no longer wants the in-app “Make it Live”/publishing help section; publishing UI visibility issue/help flow is no longer in scope.

existing_features.title: Add a new in-app help surface that explains how to publish the app permanently when the user cannot see the Go Live/Publish button in the chat UI, including clear troubleshooting steps and what the user can do as an alternative (e.g., rebuild a new draft).

Expose the new “Make it Live” help surface from the main user journeys: add a link/button on the Landing Page and add an entry point from the authenticated dashboard header area (e.g., within the user menu or adjacent header actions) so users can reach it from both home and inside a hub.
Create a dedicated route (e.g., /publish-help) for the “Make it Live” content and wire it into the TanStack Router route tree.
Remove the “Make This App Live” entry point from the Landing Page, including its click handler and any related imports/icons, so the Landing Page no longer shows publishing/help CTA UI.

Remove the “Make This App Live” entry point from the authenticated UI (user profile dropdown), including its click handler and any related imports/icons, so users cannot navigate to publish-help from inside the app.
Remove the dedicated publish help route and page from the app so /publish-help is no longer part of the TanStack Router route tree and the PublishHelpPage is not shipped.

projectName: Add in-app “Make it Live” help flow when Go Live button is not visible
